items.title: Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, 1997
items.q: Of course Sinatra was one of the few famous singers at that time, and then it became a singer’s world, you know, bands were just accompaniment.

ctx.x: They were pretty hot at this time, too. This was ‘43, ‘45?

This was ‘44. No, the summer of ‘45, I’m sorry. The summer of ‘45. Because I stayed with the band for about a year and then was drafted into the Army. But these were, I can’t even describe these terrific times. Bands were it. It didn’t change to singers being it until just a few years later. Of course Sinatra was one of the few famous singers at that time, and then it became a singer’s world, you know, bands were just accompaniment. But the big bands were great and what you see in the media about all the rock…
That they had their own fan club.
